review.by: Claude Code (model review, not a human)
notes: treasure / treasure guardian are mostly western hoard descriptions (0 eastern), so they join hoarding instead of counting as positive
omen is mostly 길조/吉兆 (27 of 41), so it joins luck; 凶兆 (2) and 징조 (5) are mislabelled as a result
beast is mostly 巨兽 / plain 'beast' with general or western tradition, so it is a neutral creature, not a monster
四灵 (four spirits) and constellation (mostly Draco) are not the zodiac
power (力量/权力) and authority (权威) describe capability or rule and are used for monsters as well as emperors, so they are neutral like control
fire breath was the same concept as fire (the extractor is told to tag 'breathes fire' as fire), split only by tag wording; merged into fire
second pass after the cap-30 re-extraction: new canonicals that duplicate reviewed ones were folded in (treasure guarder → hoarding, breath → fire, defeat → slain, robes → royalty, …)
hero / knight are neutral: in western answers they are the dragon's opponents, in eastern ones 英雄 is a metaphor for the dragon; festival is a neutral cultural fact
